course.breakaway.flavor: Starts on a Hill and ends boxed in the Corridor: no straight to fix anything.
course.canyon.flavor: Long and narrow. The Hill wears you down; the Corridor shows no mercy.
course.circuit.flavor: Curve, straight, curve. Pure speed, and a Jump at the end with no warning.
course.crossing.flavor: The longest of all. Only she who paces herself arrives in one piece.
course.open-sky.flavor: Lots of sky and an endless straight in the middle: legs and lungs.
course.overlook.flavor: Climbs, stares into the void, then dives headfirst for the finish.
course.steps.flavor: Three Jumps in a row. The rhythm breaks and you have to rebuild it.
course.ridge.flavor: Descents that push and Jumps that take your breath away.
course.sprint.flavor: Short and relentless: whoever hesitates has already lost.
ev.altair-contract-1: Contract: Altair offers a prize to race an exhibition this week.
ev.boneyard-botch-1: Botch job: the crew has an idea and a blowtorch.
ev.caracara-ground-truth: Caracara says jumping is for those who can't race. She says it staring at the ramp.
ev.caracara-scrap-run: Caracara came back from the scrapyard with a box of parts nobody asked for and a huge grin.
ev.caracara-scrap-run.opt1: Remind her today was a rest day
ev.cernicala-chart: Cernícala taped a heat chart to the hangar door. It's annotated by hand on both sides.
ev.cernicala-stillness: Cernícala has hovered over the same spot in the yard for twenty minutes, correcting millimeters.
ev.hard-loss: A tough loss. The hangar is silent.
ev.koryu-data-session-1: Data session: Kōryū wants to go over telemetry late into the night.
ev.luck-caracara-finger: Caracara pinched a finger fixing an engine that wasn't hers.
ev.luck-caracara-finger.opt0: She swears it doesn't hurt. It does.
ev.luck-caracara-hammock: Caracara hung a hammock made of old wing parts between two frames and took the nap of the year.
ev.luck-caracara-hammock.opt0: She woke up with a new idea and grease on her nose.
ev.luck-cernicala-feather: Cernícala adjusted the angle of a single feather and gained half a second on the straight.
ev.luck-cernicala-feather.opt0: She wrote it in her notebook, in tiny letters, underlined twice.
ev.luck-cernicala-notebook.opt0: She searches all week, silently and nonstop.
ev.luck-fan-letter: A letter came from a girl who saw her race. It has a drawing of her wings.
ev.luck-fan-letter.opt0: She stuck it in her locker, next to the mirror.
ev.luck-head-cold: She woke up with a cold, a red nose and a hoarse voice.
ev.luck-head-cold.opt0: Everything takes twice the effort, even the hangar stairs.
ev.luck-long-sleep: She slept twelve hours straight and nobody dared wake her.
ev.luck-long-sleep.opt0: She came down to the hangar stretching her wings, ready to fly.
ev.luck-lost-goggles: Her lucky flight goggles went missing. They turned the whole hangar upside down.
ev.luck-lost-goggles.opt0: The new ones are tight and just aren't the same.
ev.luck-peregrina-late-replay: Peregrina stayed up till three watching the replay of her first race.
ev.luck-peregrina-late-replay.opt0: Today she yawns every two minutes.
ev.luck-peregrina-thermal: Peregrina found a new line over the circuit's straight.
ev.luck-peregrina-thermal.opt0: She talked about it all through dinner.
ev.luck-radio-critic: A commentator said on the radio that her wings are just for show.
ev.luck-radio-critic.opt0: She listened to all of it without a word.
ev.luck-rival-smile: A rival greeted her on the track with a smile that wasn't a greeting.
ev.luck-rival-smile.bad: She took it home and stewed on it all week.
ev.luck-rival-smile.good: She turned it into drive, and the drive lasted all week.
ev.luck-rival-smile.opt0: She stared after her until she was out of sight.
ev.luck-sky-gust: A test pulse from the thruster launched her higher than planned.
ev.luck-sky-gust.bad: She landed shaken and took a while to recover.
ev.luck-sky-gust.good: She held it to the end, laughing.
ev.luck-stormy-night: They tested engines all night: the hangar roof shook like a drum.
ev.luck-stormy-night.opt0: Nobody slept a wink, and neither did she.
ev.luck-tailwind: A practice lap over the circuit's straight came out perfect.
ev.luck-tailwind.opt0: She repeated the lap until she understood every segment.
ev.luck-veteran-visit: A retired racer stopped by the hangar for a coffee.
ev.luck-veteran-visit.opt0: She left behind two tips worth their weight in gold.
ev.lumiere-calibration-1: Fine calibration: Lumière offers to tune the flight profile.
ev.lumiere-calibration-1.opt1: Ask them to tune for speed
ev.peregrina-first-dive: Peregrina looks at the steepest Descent on the test circuit and says nothing for a whole minute.
ev.peregrina-speed-doubt: After a weak session, Peregrina asks if the wings are holding her back or she's holding them back.
ev.peregrina-speed-doubt.opt1: Tell her she flies without telemetry tomorrow
ev.podium-interview: Post-podium interview: they ask you about the wings.
ev.sandstorm-week: Maintenance: the track closes for two days.
ev.sponsor-photo: Sponsor photo shoot. Nobody wants to go.
ev.sponsor-photo.opt1: Send the workshop in your place
ev.steinhaus-maintenance-1: Heavy maintenance: the workshop wants to strip the whole frame.
ev.steinhaus-maintenance-1.opt1: Only the urgent stuff, we need to train
log.mood.drift: She's sick of training: mood drops.
log.mood.failure: The failure got her down: mood drops.
log.mood.race-loss: The race left her down: mood drops.
log.inherit.inspiration.agility: Inheritance Inspiration: the black box passes her Agility.
log.inherit.inspiration.stamina: Inheritance Inspiration: the black box passes her Stamina.
log.inherit.inspiration.technique: Inheritance Inspiration: the black box passes her Technique.
log.inherit.inspiration.courage: Inheritance Inspiration: the black box passes her Courage.
log.inherit.inspiration.intelligence: Inheritance Inspiration: the black box passes her Intelligence.
log.inherit.none: The inheritance didn't inspire her this time.
log.inherit.capped: The inheritance inspired her, but that stat is already at the season cap.
log.vigor.exhausted: She trained with energy in the red: the fatigue led to injury.
log.vigor.rest.great: Slept like a log: recovers a lot of energy.
part.lumiere-turbine.brief: A bit faster, takes more heat
position.closer.brief: Saves energy and spends it on descents and the final sprint
position.lead.brief: Goes out front and spends to hold the lead while energy lasts
position.pack.brief: Steady pace until the final phase; then sprints like everyone
position.stalk.brief: Waits mid-pack and attacks at 70 % of the course
quirk.hot-head.brief: Heat doesn't slow her for the first 300 m
quirk.thin-air.brief: Better on hills, worse on descents
rule.mass-thrust: Mass thrust: no speed penalty from heat; excess heat drains durability ×2.
rule.mass-thrust.brief: Heat doesn't slow her, but wears the wings
rule.pulse: Pulses: boost fires in 0.8 s bursts with a 2 s cooldown.
rule.regen: Regen: +1.5 energy per second without boost; low capacity.
rule.regen.brief: Recovers energy without boost; small tank
rule.repairable: Repairable: +2 durability per Flat segment; 2 quirk slots.
rule.telemetry: Telemetry: heat never exceeds dissipation; activation +15 %; power-to-weight cap 1.1.
skill.cool-head.brief: If she heats up, she cools down and goes faster
skill.flat-cooldown.brief: More frequent pulses on the flat
skill.free-first-pulse.brief: First boost on a descent is free
skill.heat-to-energy.brief: At the end, heat turns into energy
skill.obstacle-armor.brief: Failed jumps and wet ground don't hurt her
skill.scavenger-stride.brief: Faster and no damage on jumps
skill.second-wind.brief: Extra energy if short at the end
skill.still-air.brief: Regens a bit of energy without boost
skill.talon-lock.brief: Every 2nd pulse +24 %; fast recharge on descents

ui.turn.actions.legend.v2: Gains are for a training that goes well, with mood already applied. At {safe} energy or more, training never fails, except the risk flight ({risk}); below that, the risk climbs faster and faster, up to {max} at empty energy ({riskMax} for the risk flight). The simulator fails at half that risk and gives back a bit of energy ({simulator}). A failure takes away half and lowers mood; at {injury} energy or less, and always on the risk flight, {share} of failures are injuries. Each straight week of training may lower mood, more so after {free} in a row. The secondary stat gains {secondary} of the main one. Lv is the training track's level: it rises with repeats and gives more gain.

ui.flight.cap.countdown: Charging: takes off in {m} m to the {band} band ({style}).
ui.flight.cap.takeoff: {style} to the {band} band in {s} s. Pays {cost} energy and {speed}.
ui.flight.cap.takeoffLow: Low with {style}: to the low band in {s} s. Pays {cost} energy and {speed}.
ui.flight.cap.lowBand: Low, in the low band: both lines and traffic from the others flying low.
ui.flight.cap.airClean: Up in the {band} band. Her air this flight: +{pct} % speed: clean line.
ui.flight.cap.airRough: Up in the {band} band. Her air this flight: −{pct} % speed: rough air, holding costs more.
ui.flight.cap.dirty: Dirty air: another racer in her band and line, close ahead. Holding costs more, her legs don't rest and HP drains.
ui.flight.cap.over: Over the top! {s} s in dirty air and she had the energy to climb: {from} → {to}.
ui.flight.cap.knock: Knocked down to the {to} band: {s} s in dirty air without climbing. Courage extends how long she holds the line.
ui.flight.cap.noEnergy: No energy to hold the {band} band: folds and falls with no dive. The height isn't cashed in.
ui.flight.cap.grandDive: Grand dive from the ceiling at {kmh} km/h. Every band she drops adds speed.
ui.flight.cap.nerveHeld: Drops onto traffic and holds her nerve (risk {pct} %): the dive pays more. Courage lowers that risk.
ui.flight.cap.flinch: Flinched dropping onto traffic (risk {pct} %): opens her wings, no dive.
ui.flight.cap.skillDive: {skill} (her passive): the dive gains +{kmh} km/h more; +{total} km/h in total.
ui.flight.cap.touchLoss: Touches down with no dive and pays the landing: −{kmh} km/h. Technique decides how much she loses.
ui.flight.cap.passSide: {by}: passes L{lane} side by side in the {band} band. Side by side the air is clean; the line change cost metres, not energy.
ui.flight.cap.boxedIn: Boxed in in the {band} band: L{ahead} ahead and L{lane} alongside. She can't change line: only climb or wait.
ui.flight.cap.doorClosed: Shut the door: cuts in front of L{lane}, who was coming out to pass. It costs both of them metres.
ui.flight.cap.doorOnHer: L{lane} shut the door on her: cut in front. She brakes and ends up behind again; it costs both of them metres.
ui.flight.cap.diagonal: Diagonal: climbs a band and changes line in one move.
ui.flight.cap.switchOut: Moves to the outside line to pass: costs metres of distance (Technique decides how many).
ui.flight.cap.switchIn: Moves to the inside line to pass: costs metres of distance (Technique decides how many).
ui.flight.cap.kickShort: Short kick: little HP left beyond what reaching cruise needs, so her kick spends only {pct} % of her energy.
ui.flight.cap.noKick: No HP left to kick: enough to reach cruise, not to push.
ui.flight.cap.hit: Maneuvering costs HP: −{hp} for {cause}. Stamina shrinks each hit.

ui.m.chat.title: Chat
ui.m.chat.sub: Ask her anything. It changes nothing in the season.
ui.m.chat.none: No more questions for now. Talk again later in the season.
chat.peregrina-why-race.2: If I were slow I'd do something else. Accounting, maybe. No, you have to do that fast too.
chat.peregrina-why-race.3: Next question, I'm done with this one.
chat.peregrina-day-off.q: What do you do on your day off?
chat.peregrina-day-off.1: Negative. I don't have days off. I have race days and days waiting for the race.
chat.peregrina-day-off.2: I tried reading a book once. Got to the end in twenty minutes. Skipped the middle, but I got there.
chat.peregrina-the-chief.q: What do you think of the Chief?
chat.peregrina-the-chief.1: The Chief has known me since I had training wings. She says I was born in a hurry.
chat.peregrina-the-chief.2: Not true. I was born two weeks early. Big difference.
chat.peregrina-ever-lost.2: Once I came second in a practice race. But the other one started early. Doesn't count.
chat.peregrina-ever-lost.3: Why do you ask? Does it feel like something?
chat.peregrina-favorite-track.2: Well, the one with the steepest descent. That's where the wings sing.
chat.peregrina-favorite-track.3: Long ones are… long. I don't know what else to say about them. They take forever to end.
chat.peregrina-why-koryu.1: Because it's red. Red goes faster.
chat.peregrina-why-koryu.2: It's a scientific fact. Don't look it up, just trust me.
chat.peregrina-why-koryu.3: And because the Chief told me I'd never get in. I got in the next day.
chat.peregrina-rookie-topic.1: The one with the sign? She runs well. Pretty well. Not as well as me.
chat.peregrina-rookie-topic.2: She asks me everything and writes it in a notebook. She's on her third one.
chat.peregrina-rookie-topic.3: Yesterday she asked what I have for breakfast. I said I don't, there's no time. Today she skipped breakfast. I had to give her half a croissant.
chat.peregrina-hardest-training.q: What's the hardest thing to train?
chat.peregrina-hardest-training.1: Technique. It's sitting down looking at wind charts.
chat.peregrina-hardest-training.2: Sitting. Still. Looking. Three things I don't do.
chat.peregrina-hardest-training.3: Last time smoke came out of my head. I don't know if it was the chart or me.
chat.peregrina-the-sleeper.q: Did you see the one sleeping in the stands?
chat.peregrina-the-sleeper.1: Who? I didn't see anyone. I was winning.
chat.peregrina-the-sleeper.2: Oh, the one with the cap. Yeah. Weird to fall asleep at a race. Maybe she's slow?
chat.peregrina-the-sleeper.3: The Chief was looking at her like she knew her. She wouldn't tell me who she was. That was weird too.
story.peregrina-prologue.title: Ready for takeoff
story.peregrina-prologue.1: Kōryū's pit. Monday, 7:58. The meeting was at 7:30.
story.peregrina-prologue.2: On every wall, the same poster: a Falconess in red, smiling like she has already won.
story.peregrina-prologue.3: Is that her? The one on the poster?
story.peregrina-prologue.4: That's her. Whenever she shows up.
story.peregrina-prologue.6: Tower, this is Peregrina! Final approach, runway clear… I'm here!
story.peregrina-prologue.7: Half an hour late. A personal best.
story.peregrina-prologue.8: Negative, Chief. I got here super fast. I just left late. Big difference.
story.peregrina-prologue.9: You must be the one training me. Peregrina, Kōryū Racing. Ready for takeoff.
story.peregrina-prologue.10: Nice to meet you. Tell me, what's your plan for the season?
story.peregrina-prologue.13: …There's an after? Perfect, we'll see it on the track!
story.peregrina-prologue.14: And she was gone. One of the posters swayed in the wind she left behind.
story.peregrina-debut.title: No need to warm up
story.peregrina-debut.1: Race week. In the stands, someone holds up a handmade sign: “FLY, PEREGRINA!”
story.peregrina-debut.2: That sign… do you know her?
story.peregrina-debut.3: A rookie from the school. I signed her cap on Tuesday. And Wednesday. And Thursday.
story.peregrina-debut.4: Do people always wait for you like that?
story.peregrina-debut.5: Everybody waits for me. That's what happens when you get there first.
story.peregrina-debut.6: Before the start, ten minutes of warm-up. No arguing.
story.peregrina-debut.7: Ten minutes is a really long time. What if I warm up fast?
story.peregrina-debut.10: Three laps of the straight in the time of a yawn. She comes back without a hair out of place.
story.peregrina-debut.11: Three laps like that and you're not even tired?
story.peregrina-debut.12: Tired? I don't even know how that works. Are we starting? How about now?
story.peregrina-debut-win.title: Can we go again tomorrow?
story.peregrina-debut-win.1: First. There was hardly a race.
story.peregrina-debut-win.2: Landing confirmed! When's the next one?
story.peregrina-debut-win.3: In a few weeks. How did the final straight feel?
story.peregrina-debut-win.4: The final straight? Fast. Like everything.
story.peregrina-debut-win.5: She says it smiling. But she's breathing harder than she lets on.
story.peregrina-debut-win.7: Rest? Isn't there another one tomorrow?
story.peregrina-debut-win.8: Peregrina! Peregrina! Will you sign my cap?
story.peregrina-debut-win.9: She signs without stopping. The autograph covers the whole visor and some of the rookie's forehead.
story.peregrina-debut-win.10: Did you see?! She didn't even slow down to sign!
story.peregrina-debut-win.11: Go sign caps somewhere else, champ. And tomorrow at 7:30.
story.peregrina-tears.title: It was just a race
story.peregrina-tears.1: After a practice race. Cernícala sits alone by the track, visor in hand.
story.peregrina-tears.2: She came second. Behind Peregrina, by a wing.
story.peregrina-tears.3: Good race! You flew well on the descent. You almost caught me.
story.peregrina-tears.5: A tear slips out of Cernícala's eye. She wipes it away fast, as if it never happened.
story.peregrina-tears.6: Is she crying? It was a race. There's another one next week.
story.peregrina-tears.7: I think this race mattered to her.
story.peregrina-tears.8: It mattered to me too. That's why I won.
story.peregrina-tears.9: Has it never happened to you? Wanting something a lot and not getting it?
story.peregrina-tears.11: She means the question. That's why it sounds worse.
story.peregrina-warmup.title: Going slow
story.peregrina-warmup.1: Today we try something different: warm up slowly. Really slowly.
story.peregrina-warmup.3: On purpose. I want to see how you breathe when you're not at full speed.
story.peregrina-warmup.4: Understood. Slow. I can do slow.
story.peregrina-warmup.5: She takes a step. Thinks about it. Takes another step. Thinks harder.
story.peregrina-warmup.9: Twelve?! It feels like a whole season went by!
story.peregrina-warmup.10: She runs the last lap at full speed. “To make up for it,” she explains.
story.peregrina-warmup.11: It's harder for her to slow down than to run. Did you notice?
story.peregrina-press.title: The face on the poster
story.peregrina-press.1: First again. This time the cameras are waiting.
story.peregrina-press.2: A reporter holds out a microphone: “How does it feel to be the Falconess everyone wants to be?”
story.peregrina-press.4: He waits for more. She's already reading the race calendar over his shoulder.
story.peregrina-press.5: That one? The long one at the end? Can I run it sooner?
story.peregrina-press.6: That one… we'll look at it later. First, the next one.
story.peregrina-rookie.title: Not applicable
story.peregrina-rookie.1: The rookie with the sign now trains at Kōryū's pit. She wears her hair like Peregrina, walks like Peregrina, shows up late like Peregrina.
story.peregrina-rookie.2: Peregrina! A question for my notebook. What does losing feel like?
story.peregrina-rookie.4: I don't know. Never happened to me.
story.peregrina-rookie.6: The rookie runs off at full speed to tell someone. She trips over a toolbox.
story.peregrina-rookie.8: Nice! That's how you take off.
story.peregrina-rookie.9: And if it happens to you some day? Losing, I mean.
story.peregrina-rookie.10: Then the rookie will have to erase that page. And she hates erasing.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.title: A track you can't win by running
story.peregrina-chief-warning.1: Night at the pit. The Chief checks Peregrina's wings piece by piece, without hurrying.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.2: Why is this taking so long? They work. They work super fast.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.3: Let her work. I want to learn how they're looked after.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.4: I've known her since she had training wings. Always the same: first she takes off, then she thinks.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.5: That's how I get there first.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.6: Some day you'll get a track you can't win by running.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.8: Peregrina leaves whistling. The Chief tightens one more bolt.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.9: Did you mean something in particular?
story.peregrina-chief-warning.10: I mean you've seen it too. She runs out of air on the long ones.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.11: I've seen it. But she's so happy… I don't want to put that out.
story.peregrina-chief-warning.12: Then train her so it doesn't go out on its own.
story.peregrina-nap.title: The one who was sleeping
story.peregrina-nap.1: First, again. The stands rise to their feet.
story.peregrina-nap.2: All of the stands except one.
story.peregrina-nap.3: In the top row, a Falconess naps with her cap over her face, as if the race were background music.
story.peregrina-nap.5: Did you see how I braked on the last descent? Not even the wings noticed!
story.peregrina-nap.6: I saw it. It was amazing. And did you see the one sleeping up there?
story.peregrina-nap.7: Who sleeps at a race? She must be slow.
story.peregrina-nap.8: The Chief isn't looking at the track. She's looking at the top row.
story.peregrina-first-vos.title: You were right
story.peregrina-first-vos.1: After training. Peregrina arrives at the pit soaked and, for the first time, walking.
story.peregrina-first-vos.2: The pool. I hate it. It's slow, it's wet, there's no wind.
story.peregrina-first-vos.3: I know. And still you went all three times I asked.
story.peregrina-first-vos.4: Because in the last race I still had air at the end. That never happened before.
story.peregrina-first-vos.6: You were right. About training differently.
story.peregrina-first-vos.7: Did you just drop the formal “you”?
story.peregrina-first-vos.9: I like it better this way.
story.peregrina-first-vos.10: What else is there? I want to try something I don't know how to do.
story.peregrina-first-vos.11: Tomorrow, pool. The day after, pool. And on Thursday, a surprise.
story.peregrina-summit.title: The summit
story.peregrina-summit.1: The fourth goal. Three for three so far. The stands full as far as the eye can see.
story.peregrina-summit.2: In every row, a red poster. On every poster, her.
story.peregrina-summit.4: Do you hear that? That's the sound of being on top.
story.peregrina-summit.6: Nervous? Never. …A little. It's a lot of noise for just one person.
story.peregrina-summit.7: It's windy up there. Hold on.
story.peregrina-summit.9: Then fly. I'll be waiting at the finish.
story.peregrina-summit.10: She puts on her helmet. For one second, just one, she stands still.
story.peregrina-end-failed.title: What do we do now?
story.peregrina-end-failed.1: The track empties. So do the stands.
story.peregrina-end-failed.2: Peregrina is still standing on the straight, helmet in hand.
story.peregrina-end-failed.5: I was fast. As fast as always.
story.peregrina-end-failed.6: A loose poster tumbles across the track. She doesn't pick it up.
story.peregrina-end-failed.8: So… what do we do now?
story.peregrina-end-failed.9: Now we stay here a while. There's no hurry.
story.peregrina-end-failed.10: For the first time all season, Peregrina stands still.
story.peregrina-invitation.title: The invitation
story.peregrina-invitation.1: Four races, four wins. The stands are still shouting her name when a red envelope arrives at the pit.
story.peregrina-invitation.2: She's invited to the great Long race. End of the season. The longest race of the year.
story.peregrina-invitation.4: Peregrina, before you decide… that distance is very different from anything you've run.
story.peregrina-invitation.8: If I fly faster, it gets shorter.
story.peregrina-invitation.9: She says it with such clean joy that nobody dares to answer.
story.peregrina-invitation.10: …Then we have eight weeks. Let's use them well.
story.peregrina-invitation.11: The Chief puts the envelope in a drawer. Under it is an old photo of another Falconess, asleep in a grandstand.
story.peregrina-tiresome.title: How tiring
story.peregrina-tiresome.1: Distance training. Peregrina is on her twelfth lap. She ran the first eleven flat out.
story.peregrina-tiresome.2: Another! I'll do this one faster.
story.peregrina-tiresome.3: Stop for a second. Drink some water. Can I ask you something?
story.peregrina-tiresome.5: In the Long race, when you run out of air… what do you plan to do?
story.peregrina-tiresome.7: By the side of the track, someone is lying in the grass, watching the clouds.
story.peregrina-tiresome.10: Milana. I run the Long race. Well, I walk it a little.
story.peregrina-tiresome.11: Tomorrow, pool. The day after, pool. Until the Long race, a little every day.
story.peregrina-long.title: The Long race
story.peregrina-long.1: Week 48. The great Long race. Three thousand six hundred meters: three times her Sprint.
story.peregrina-long.2: Peregrina does her usual ritual: helmet, three little hops, a look at the finish.
story.peregrina-long.4: It's far. How do you feel?
story.peregrina-long.6: I'm asking for one thing: save air for the end.
story.peregrina-long.8: At the start, Milana yawns. Stretches. Yawns again.
story.peregrina-long.9: Hey, fast one. Make it a long one.
story.peregrina-long.11: The signal. Peregrina is off first, as always.
ui.m.race.goal.run: Goal: run it. Any place will do.
ui.m.race.named.milana: Milana races: a Falconess built for the Long race, who saves her air for the end. The whole field is built for stamina.
story.peregrina-long-lost.title: What do we do now?
story.peregrina-long-lost.1: Four hundred meters from the end, her strength ran out. Her wings were still open; she had nothing left to push them with.
story.peregrina-long-lost.2: Milana passed her breathing easy, like someone out for a walk.
story.peregrina-long-lost.3: She crosses the line. She stays standing on the straight, helmet in hand.
story.peregrina-long-lost.6: I was fast. As fast as always.
story.peregrina-long-lost.7: I don't know what to do now. Should I be sad? Angry? I can't do either.
story.peregrina-long-lost.8: You don't have to feel anything yet.
story.peregrina-long-lost.9: Come, sit down. Breathe with me: in… out.
story.peregrina-long-lost.10: She breathes. Once. Again. Slowly, like Milana.
story.peregrina-long-lost.11: So… what do we do now?
story.peregrina-long-lost.12: Now we stay here a while. There's no hurry.
story.peregrina-long-lost.13: For the first time all season, Peregrina stands still.
story.peregrina-long-won.title: My model Falconess
story.peregrina-long-won.1: She runs the last hundred meters with her lungs on fire.
story.peregrina-long-won.2: She crosses first. By half a length. And sits down hard on the track.
story.peregrina-long-won.4: It's over. You won. Breathe slowly, with me.
story.peregrina-long-won.6: And it was awful. Long races are definitely not my thing.
story.peregrina-long-won.8: Milana offers her a hand. Peregrina takes it, and takes a while to let go.
story.peregrina-long-won.9: How do you still have air left? I want to know. Everything.
story.peregrina-long-won.10: How tiring… I'll explain tomorrow. Slowly.
story.peregrina-long-won.11: I'm going back to Sprints. But now I know you can't win everything with speed.
story.peregrina-long-won.13: The pool too. …My model Falconess says so.
story.peregrina-long-won.14: In the stands, Milana yawns. Peregrina waves at her with both hands.
